d:
France and Serbia delivered an unforgettable battle at EuroBasket 2011, with EVERYTHING coming down to the final possession!
Tony Parker led France with 24 points, while Serbia fought until the very end in a game that went to overtime. With just one point separating the teams, Serbia had a chance to steal the win, but the final shot near the basket didn't fall!
France escaped with a dramatic 97-96 victory in one of the most thrilling games of EuroBasket 2011.
